items.title: EventoApp.io
items.subtitle: Event creation and ticket sales
items.description: A complete online event creation platform. I co-built and developed EventoApp.io as CTO, managing the entire stack: frontend PWA with Next.js/React, backend Express/MongoDB, state management via Zustand, real-time communication with Socket.io, and integration of a modular REST API. The app allows creating events with custom RSVPs, co-hosts, media uploads, upcoming chat features, and discovery via interest filters. Automated deployment through CI/CD.

items.title: Hydro Marketplace
items.subtitle: Web3 NFT on Cosmos
items.description: A decentralized marketplace to sell and buy NFT assets linked to the Cosmos blockchain. I contributed as a Frontend Developer using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, CosmosKit, and Supabase.

items.title: Tree Transplantation
items.subtitle: Online catalog
items.description: Development of a multilingual showcase website (FR/EN) presenting tree transplantation equipment. Added and optimized product sections (catalog with filters, product sheets), improved SEO (title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph), and enabled smooth content updates via CMS. Full-stack work including mobile/desktop-friendly frontend integration, i18n management, and quote request form handling.

items.title: Zephyrus
items.subtitle: Web3 NFT Aggregator on CosmosHub
items.description: NFT aggregator on CosmosHub. I contributed as a Frontend Developer using Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, and CosmosKit. The goal was to simplify and gamify the user experience of https://hydro.cosmos.network/

items.title: Lima Prod
items.subtitle: Video production, France, Vietnam, Asia
items.description: Partial redesign of the Wix site for Lima Prod. I added and structured new sections to improve content readability, optimized SEO by updating metadata (title, description, OG images), and improved the heading hierarchy. The goal was to better position the site on search engines and enhance the user experience.
